description_en: Enables or disables the native replication mode for an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 调用ModifyDBInstanceReplicationSwitch接口开启或关闭RDS原生复制模式
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-instance-replication-switch --db-instance-id 'rm-bp*****' --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --external-replication ON --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceReplicationSwitch

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26243.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the native replication mode. Valid values:
ON: enables the native replication mode.
OFF: disables the native replication mode
parameters.help_zh:
开启或关闭原生复制模式，取值说明：
ON：开启。
OFF：关闭
parameters.name: external_replication

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. This parameter can be left empty
parameters.name: resource_group_id
